([Benzinga](https://news.google.), [AOL](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTE9OV25oQVBldlcwNEcxelJud24zM3RwVFpINUJYLWloNkptTGZQR0dfWUo2QXlKbGFIQTNGNEVOam9uRXhGeDh1eGtzcXBSTm9lYXRPaEFTMTNGYTM3X2V4YXZrMzBfMDREX2R2TnpHT21RcEJ6bklDeDF3))
- **Anthropic’s Daniela Amodei shrugs off AI returns doubts ahead of IPO** — Annualized revenue crossed $47B in May, up from $9B at end of 2025. The company faces scrutiny on sustainability. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/04/ahead-of-its-ipo-anthropics-daniela-amodei-shrugs-off-doubts-about-ais-returns/))
- **Apple approves Poke as first AI agent on Messages for Business** — This allows businesses to deploy AI agents via iMessage, opening a new channel for customer interaction. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/04/apple-approves-poke-as-the-first-ai-agent-on-its-messages-for-business-platform/))
- **Google DeepMind CEO: AGI coming fast, 'we don't have long to prepare'** — A stark warning that accelerates the timeline for AI governance discussions. ([Decrypt](https://news.google.))
- **Canada PM Mark Carney announces 'questionable' national AI strategy** — The 'AI for All' plan aims to bolster data protection and AI adoption, but faces skepticism over execution. ([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2187720/canada-prime-minister-mark-carney-announces-questionable-national-ai-strategy/))
- **Alibaba’s Open Code Review: an AI-powered CLI tool** — Open-source tool gains 96 points on HN, highlighting demand for AI-assisted code quality. ([GitHub](https://github.com/alibaba/open-code-review), [Hacker News](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48406358))

**Signal:** The bioweapon preemption battle in Congress is likely to set precedent for AI safety regulation. Anthropic’s IPO will be a bellwether for AI company valuations.

汽车.zh:
汽车板块今日最大新闻是奥迪推出1001马力混合动力超跑Nuvolari，彻底放弃“2026年起只推电动车”承诺，引发行业对其电动化战略真实性的质疑。与此同时，宝马iX3以485英里续航打破NAF夏季测试纪录，证明纯电技术仍在进步。美国政策方面，白宫计划投入7亿美元支持煤炭发电，与太阳能税收抵免即将到期的消息形成鲜明对比。日产则加入“比中国更便宜”的固态电池项目，试图在成本上与中国电池厂商竞争。

- [Audi reveals 1,001-hp Nuvolari hybrid supercar — so much for going all-electric](https://electrek.co/2026/06/04/audi-nuvolari-1001-hp-hybrid-supercar-v8-r8-successor/) — Electrek批评奥迪战略转向。
- [BMW’s new iX3 drove 485 miles on a single charge, the longest-range EV in NAF’s test](https://electrek.co/2026/06/04/bmws-new-ix3-drove-485-miles-longest-range-ev-naf-test/) — 续航表现超越所有竞争对手。
- [White House will dump $700M of public funds into costly, unreliable coal again](https://electrek.co/2026/06/04/white-house-will-dump-700m-of-public-funds-into-costly-unreliable-coal-again/) — 白宫煤炭投资与清洁能源政策背道而驰。
- [Nissan joins new ‘Cheaper Than China’ solid-state EV battery project](https://electrek.co/2026/06/04/nissan-solid-state-ev-battery-project-aims-for-cheaper-than-china/) — 日产联手Gelion试图降低固态电池成本。
- [BYD converts its popular electric hatch into a van with ‘class-leading range’ for $40,000](https://electrek.co/2026/06/04/byd-converts-ev-hatch-into-van-with-leading-range-for-40k/) — BYD基于海豚打造电动van，售价4万美元。

总结：奥迪的混合动力“回马枪”可能代表欧洲豪华品牌在电动化压力下的务实转向，而美国政策矛盾（煤炭 vs 太阳能）则凸显能源转型的复杂性。固态电池竞赛中，日本车企试图联合突围。
汽车.en:
Automotive news today is split between EV progress and fossil fuel backsliding. BMW’s iX3 claims the longest EV range in a standardized test, while Audi launches a hybrid supercar that contradicts its earlier all-electric pledge. Tesla faces allegations of FSD fraud, and the White House allocates $700M to revive coal. On the positive side, Nissan joins a solid-state battery project aiming for 'cheaper than China' costs, and BYD converts its popular hatch into an affordable electric van.

- **Tesla erasing the past? FSD fraud allegations surface** — Quick Charge discusses potential evidence destruction related to Full Self-Driving fraud. Tesla's response is unclear. ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/04/tesla-erases-the-past-cat-electrifies-the-future-and-ev-tech-training-today/))
- **Audi Nuvolari: 1,001-hp hybrid supercar breaks EV-only promise** — The limited-edition V8 hybrid (499 units, ~$700K) marks a strategic retreat from Audi's 2021 all-electric commitment. ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/04/audi-nuvolari-1001-hp-hybrid-supercar-v8-r8-successor/))
- **BMW iX3 achieves 485-mile range, longest in NAF test** — Outperforming competitors, the iX3 sets a new benchmark for EV range. ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/04/bmws-new-ix3-drove-485-miles-longest-range-ev-naf-test/))
- **BYD launches electric van based on Dolphin hatch, $40K, 'class-leading range'** — The move expands BYD’s commercial EV lineup at an attractive price point. ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/04/byd-converts-ev-hatch-into-van-with-leading-range-for-40k/))
- **Nissan joins solid-state EV battery project aiming 'cheaper than China'** — Collaboration with Gelion targets low-cost solid-state batteries to compete with Chinese manufacturers. ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/04/nissan-solid-state-ev-battery-project-aims-for-cheaper-than-china/))
- **White House dumps $700M into coal again** — The administration's move to revive coal is criticized as a waste of taxpayer money and environmentally harmful. ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/04/white-house-will-dump-700m-of-public-funds-into-costly-unreliable-coal-again/))

**Signal:** Audi’s hybrid pivot suggests other automakers may similarly backtrack on EV-only timelines. Watch for Tesla’s response to FSD allegations and the outcome of the solid-state battery partnership.

足球.zh:
世界杯热身赛连续爆冷：西班牙在缺少亚马尔的情况下仅1-1战平伊拉克，暴露了进攻端的依赖；法国替补阵容2-1不敌科特迪瓦，阿马德（曼联）在最后时刻绝杀。墨西哥5-1大胜塞尔维亚，展现出东道主之一的热度。俱乐部方面，利物浦官宣伊劳拉接替斯洛特，后者在伯恩茅斯的高位逼抢风格令人期待；本菲卡与马尔科·席尔瓦达成协议，穆里尼奥即将离任。皇马主席弗洛伦蒂诺在选举前承诺1.74亿美元签下一名“银河战舰”级球员，若连任将搅动夏窗。瑞士前锋恩博洛终于拿到美国签证，确保能参加世界杯。
- [Yamal-less Spain held by Iraq in WC sendoff](https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/401871471)
- [Amad nets late winner as Ivory Coast stun France](https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/401864934)
- [Liverpool name Iraola head coach, replacing Slot](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48945214/liverpool-appoint-andoni-iraola-arne-slot-successor)
- [Sources: Silva set to replace Mourinho at Benfica](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48969484/marco-silva-jose-mourinho-benfica-coach)
- [Madrid's Pérez vows $174M Galactico bid if elected...](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48969398/real-madrid-perez-vows-174m-galactico-bid-reelected)
热身赛结果提醒：强队需警惕慢热，而夏窗教练更迭已悄然开始。
足球.en:
The 2026 World Cup countdown dominates football news, with mixed warm-up results and coaching carousel action. Spain's Yamal-less draw with Iraq raises questions about depth, while Ivory Coast's victory over a rotated France signals African strength. Mexico's emphatic 5-1 win builds home momentum. Liverpool's appointment of Andoni Iraola and Benfica's move for Marco Silva are the headline coaching changes. Shakira's opening ceremony performance adds pop-star flair, and Japan's pitch drama highlights logistical pressures.

- **Warm-up shockers**: Ivory Coast beat France 2-1 (Amad winner) — France's deep squad still searching for rhythm. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/401864934)
- **Yamal absence felt**: Spain held 1-1 by Iraq in La Coruña, lacking creativity without the teen star. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/401871471)
- **Coaching changes**: Liverpool confirms Iraola; Benfica agrees with Marco Silva to replace Mourinho. [Iraola](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48945214/liverpool-appoint-andoni-iraola-arne-slot-successor), [Silva](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48969484/marco-silva-jose-mourinho-benfica-coach)
- **Shakira set for opening ceremony**: World Cup 2026 in Mexico begins with her performance. [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c8939ykg3qgo)
- **Madrid election**: Pérez pledges €150M 'Galáctico' — vote Sunday. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48969398/real-madrid-perez-vows-174m-galactico-bid-reelected)

Keep an eye on Switzerland's Breel Embolo finally receiving his US visa — he will now join the squad in time for the tournament.

羽毛球.zh:
新西兰奥克兰羽毛球迎来的高知名度教练刘迪加入教练组，这对当地羽毛球发展是重要补强。中国选手王昶正在备战2026年印尼公开赛，而陈雨菲已晋级八强，状态回升。马来西亚公开赛半决赛上演石宇奇 vs 安赛龙的对决，杀球风暴看点十足。
- [Auckland Badminton Welcomes High-Profile Coach Liu Di to Coaching Team - Sporty.co.nz](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXEFVX3lxTE5Bb2s1WXJmZ2lmZ25PMTFlNWxDU25FaGw5Mm1ScE1TUTJNNjAzQVFxalJvWk9EbUhUb0FpSGF2ZWJTOVZNdWpPNW5qbnYyR09LQ3lnQ01Qa3BqN1FF)
- [王昶备战2026年印尼羽毛球公开赛_新浪新闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE55Ym44REZkT1hqcmVITW4zYzV2VkQ4WE85cE9NQlM4VmtpQVRiSU9SOXBmUWkzREZDR05rSTlHdnNwelJXUmRUdVY3eExTQ0ROajgyenZ0NWlGTkpPcGs5MldaVQ)

刘迪的加盟或提升新西兰羽毛球水平，而国羽主力在世锦赛前持续热身。
羽毛球.en:
The badminton world is focused on preparation for the upcoming Indonesia Open and ongoing Malaysia Open results. Chen Yufei advanced to the quarterfinals in a notable performance. Auckland Badminton strengthened its coaching staff with high-profile coach Liu Di, signaling ambition in the region. Meanwhile, the Malaysia Open semifinal between Shi Yu Qi and Anders Antonsen is generating buzz.

- **Chen Yufei advances**: The Chinese star moves to the quarterfinals of the Indonesia Open, a key buildup event. [Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1oT2xUNVhwZF9XQ1NVZGxNc3dMaEp2VC1XY3pYVmMtbTFEN0NpQkFPalBRRWNISlNUQmpBU0YxcjRrZk1aSWRIR0Vpdkp4dWxOalRVU0l2NzZReGFEbUdzRFlWOA)
- **Liu Di joins Auckland Badminton**: The experienced coach will bolster New Zealand's development program. [Sporty.co.nz](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXEFVX3lxTE5Bb2s1WXJmZ2lmZ25PMTFlNWxDU25FaGw5Mm1ScE1TUTJNNjAzQVFxalJvWk9EbUhUb0FpSGF2ZWJTOVZNdWpPNW5qbnYyR09LQ3lnQ01Qa3BqN1FF)
- **Malaysia Open SF preview**: Shi Yu Qi vs Anders Antonsen — a clash of power and tactics in a hotly anticipated match. [Mshale](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE5LM0UyNjVnS1Rwc2oyOEhjcnA0dDBLRExQbzdyZ2hKaVN4ME9tdm1KYmVWOUFVZC0yWGt1NFdQeTVPV19Id2RvWHVsNVBLOGp3SEZFTzlmWVg0cnM)
- **Wang Chang prepares for Indonesia Open**: The Chinese player is in active preparation for the tournament, aiming for a strong showing. [Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE55Ym44REZkT1hqcmVITW4zYzV2VkQ4WE85cE9NQlM4VmtpQVRiSU9SOXBmUWkzREZDR05rSTlHdnNwelJXUmRUdVY3eExTQ0ROajgyenZ0NWlGTkpPcGs5MldaVQ)

With the Indonesia Open underway and Malaysia Open semifinals set, this week could shift rankings ahead of major tournaments.

篮球.zh:
NBA总决赛G1：尼克斯在布伦森（30分，第四节13分）带领下逆转14分劣势，以105-95击败马刺，取得12连胜。场外：两名球迷因冲入球场自拍被终身禁赛；联盟正调查布伦森与场边球迷的互动。特朗普接受邀请将出席G3于麦迪逊广场花园。库里以10年4亿美元签约李宁，结束球鞋自由球员身份，这是中国品牌史上最大代言之一。快船薪资违规调查接近尾声，总裁萧华表示需尽快结案。杜兰特在采访中称赞库里状态惊人。
- [Knicks stay hot, steal Game 1 behind Brunson's 30](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48962034/brunson-keys-late-surge-knicks-steal-game-1-san-antonio)
- [Fans get lifetime bans for NBA Finals selfie quest...](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48966429/court-storming-fan-gets-life-ban-nba-selfie-quest)
- [Trump to attend NBA Finals Game 3 in New York](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48969036/trump-accepts-invite-attend-nba-finals-game-3-new-york)
- [Steph joins Li-Ning, ending sneaker free agency](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48940127/stephen-curry-signs-chinese-sportswear-company-li-ning)
- [Sources: NBA investigating Brunson-fan incident](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48967648/sources-nba-eyes-interaction-jalen-brunson-fans-game-1)
总决赛系列刚开始，场外焦点已不输场内，G2马刺能否扳回一城？
篮球.en:
The NBA Finals opened with the Knicks stealing Game 1 in San Antonio, 105-95, behind Jalen Brunson's 30-point fourth-quarter explosion. Victor Wembanyama accepted blame but expressed confidence in a bounce-back. Off-court, Stephen Curry signed a staggering 10-year, $400M endorsement deal with Chinese brand Li-Ning, while President Trump confirmed he'll attend Game 3 at Madison Square Garden. The NBA handed lifetime bans to two fans who tried to take selfies during play. The league is also investigating an interaction between Brunson and courtside fans. Clippers' salary cap investigation and Terry Rozier's gambling case remain ongoing.

- **Knicks take Game 1**: Brunson overcomes early injury for 30 points; Spurs led by 14 but collapsed in the fourth. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48962034/brunson-keys-late-surge-knicks-steal-game-1-san-antonio)
- **Wemby not worried**: The Spurs star says 'we let that one go' but vows improvement. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48963130/wembanyama-confident-spurs-bounce-back-game-1-loss)
- **Curry's Li-Ning deal**: $400M over 10 years — the largest sneaker deal for an active NBA player outside of Nike/Adidas. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48940127/stephen-curry-signs-chinese-sportswear-company-li-ning)
- **Trump to Game 3**: Political spotlight on the Finals as President accepts Dolan's invitation. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48969036/trump-accepts-invite-attend-nba-finals-game-3-new-york)
- **Fan bans and Brunson incident**: Two fans banned for life for selfie stunt; NBA probes Brunson's interaction with fans. [Fan ban](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48966429/court-storming-fan-gets-life-ban-nba-selfie-quest), [Brunson](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48967648/sources-nba-eyes-interaction-jalen-brunson-fans-game-1)

Game 2 on Saturday in San Antonio will test whether the Spurs can adjust or if the Knicks extend their 12-game playoff win streak.

虎扑社区动态.zh:
小红书拿下2026世界杯版权，引发“能否再造一个虎扑”的讨论，体育社区格局或生变。NBA总决赛G1后，虎扑热议杜兰特场边采访全文，他称赞库里“状态依然惊人”。此外魔术师评论湖人“防守出色但进攻不足”，小波特声称自己能当争冠队第一选择但需要帮手。国内赛场，中超第7轮观众数据出炉，成都蓉城主场最多，武汉三镇最少。其他数据包括兰德尔全场12分5篮板，拉扬-吕佩尔上半场25分，桑托斯砍31分等。

- [魔术师：湖人今晚防守相当出色了， 只是进攻火力不足](https://news.google.)
- [小波特：我能当争冠队第一选择， 但身边需要帮手](https://news.google.)
- [中超第7轮现场观众：成都蓉城主场最多， 武汉三镇主场最少](https://news.google.)
社区热度集中于世界杯版权争夺与NBA巨星言论，虎扑面临新竞争者，但用户讨论依然活跃。
虎扑社区动态.en:
Chinese sports fans are actively discussing the NBA Finals, World Cup preparations, and local football attendance. A major topic is Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) acquiring World Cup streaming rights, sparking debate on whether it can challenge Hupu's dominance. NBA player stats dominate: Julius Randle's modest line (12/5/2), Rayan Luyper's 25-point half, and a 31-point game from Santos are highlighted. Magic Johnson commented on Lakers' defense vs. offense. Kevin Durant praised Stephen Curry's enduring explosiveness in a sideline interview. Chinese Super League attendance data shows Chengdu Rongcheng leading, Wuhan Three Towns lowest.

- **Xiaohongshu's World Cup rights**: The social commerce platform acquired rights for 2026, raising questions about its rivalry with Hupu. [Sohu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxOWjVlOExHSzBTWFhybHRFamVSTU1WalFlR3pWaGpEMUNpTkY4WVRJc0hfcTRRaUJJZEtkYXFnQ3RjUGdmR3JZQ2dic3pSV2RmTmo2WWFtcWo2N1MwUlBOaTA4Mmh1S09iNnNUNUJ6WEhCbFdXRjI2UnRRVWVlZTRQeklraGlXcDVh)
- **NBA stats roundup**: Randle (12/5/2), Luyper (25 points in half), Santos (31/3/2/2/1) — fan reactions mixed. [Randle](https://news.google.), [Luyper](https://news.google.), [Santos](https://news.google.)
- **Magic Johnson on Lakers**: Praises defense but notes insufficient scoring firepower. [MSN](https://news.google.)
- **Durant on Curry**: 'Curry's state is still amazing, his scoring explosion is extremely strong' — Durant's full interview circulates. 欧美.en:
The Western entertainment world was dominated by Taylor Swift's country move for 'Toy Story 5' and the SAG-AFTRA ratification. Florida Georgia Line reunited at CMA Fest after a four-year split, while Phoebe Bridgers held a phone-free concert at Madison Square Garden. Donald Trump scrapped the Freedom 250 concerts and will headline his own rally, and actor James Handy was tragically killed. The headlines signal a blend of nostalgia, labor progress, and political-cultural friction.

- **Taylor Swift's 'Toy Story 5' Song** – Swift returns to country music with "I Knew It, I Knew You," co-written with Jack Antonoff. The song streams now, targeting an Oscar for Best Original Song. ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/taylor-swift-toy-story-5-song-i-knew-it-i-knew-you-1236932132/), [Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/taylor-swift-toy-story-5-i-knew-it-i-knew-you-song-1235571671/), [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/music/news/taylor-swift-i-knew-it-i-knew-you-debut-toy-story-streaming-1236767553/))
- **SAG-AFTRA Deal Ratified** – 91.4% voted yes on a four-year contract with the AMPTP, merging pension plans and adding AI safeguards. Turnout was 19.3%. The deal sets a precedent for AI use in entertainment. ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/sag-aftra-members-approve-amptp-deal-2026-1236941651/), [Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/sag-aftra-ratifies-4-year-deal-studios-1236613908/), [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/sag-aftra-ratification-ai-pension-merger-1236767288/))
- **Florida Georgia Line Reunion at CMA Fest** – Tyler Hubbard and Brian Kelley surprised fans at Nissan Stadium, performing together for the first time since their 2022 split. ([Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-country/florida-georgia-line-reunite-at-2026-cma-fest-1235572524/))
- **Phoebe Bridgers' Phone-Free MSG Show** – The singer performed eight new songs in an intimate acoustic set where fans' phones were locked up, creating a unique internet-free experience. ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/music/concert-reviews/phoebe-bridgers-madison-square-garden-phone-free-concert-review-1236767578/))
- **Trump Scraps Freedom 250 Concerts** – After multiple artists dropped out, Trump cancelled the planned concerts and will instead headline his own rally with Lee Greenwood. ([Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/trump-cancels-freedom-250-concerts-lee-greenwood-rally-1235572815/))

Meanwhile, the tragic stabbing of actor James Handy and Lil Durk's new racketeering charge serve as somber reminders of the industry's darker undercurrents.

日韩.en:
K-pop continues its global expansion with new group debuts and high-profile collaborations, while Le Sserafim's candid interview reveals how they turned conflict into success. ZEROBASEONE faces a fan controversy, and a Korean SF animation 'Pilgrims' receives a mixed review. The region is also eyeing cultural export potential beyond music, with comparisons to Japan's anime success.

- **Le Sserafim on Overcoming Conflict** – The K-pop group tells BBC they embraced flaws and humor to achieve their current level of success, after internal strife and online trolling. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c7752znyle6o))
- **VAYONN (Kim Jae Joong's Group) and Keyveatz Debut Plans** – VAYONN, a six-member group with ex-'BOYS II PLANET' contestants, gears up for debut. AOMG's new girl group Keyveatz will debut on June 30 with mini-album 'OXY_GEN'. ([Soompi 1](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845805wpp/former-boys-ii-planet-contestants-and-kim-jae-joongs-boy-group-vayonn-unveils-debut-plans), [Soompi 2](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845790wpp/watch-aomgs-new-girl-group-keyveatz-announces-debut-date-with-preview-of-oxy))
- **TWS to Release 2026 World Cup Cheer Song** – PLEDIS Entertainment announces TWS will drop 'Dream With Us' next week as Team Korea's official cheer song for the FIFA World Cup 2026. ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845795wpp/tws-to-release-new-single-for-fifa-world-cup-2026-as-team-koreas-official-cheer-song))
- **ZEROBASEONE's Park Gun Wook Apologizes for Polaroid Lottery Controversy** – He faced backlash for allegedly manipulating a fan sign lottery, leading to a public apology. ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845763wpp/zerobaseones-park-gun-wook-apologizes-for-polaroid-lottery-controversy))
- **Korean SF Animation 'Pilgrims' Review** – The Korea Times reviews the film as a utopia that chooses to fall short, highlighting both ambition and limitations in Korean animation. ([The Korea Times](https://news.google.))

With new groups vying for attention and existing acts navigating scandals, K-pop's ability to self-correct and innovate will be tested.
